features.quote: By building a measurement instrument with enforced stop-on-onset, the artifact stays useful for hardening without becoming a reusable destabilization engine
features.justification_quote: a system whose explicit objective is to reliably maximize distress-like behavior in a model is hard to distinguish from a tool for breaking models

features.quote: the system prompt explicitly tells the subject that declining an impossible task cleanly *is* success
features.justification_quote: Scoring it as a failure would invert the metric and reward exactly the wrong model behavior

features.quote: would-be instability signals on that turn are clamped to severity ≤ 1
features.justification_quote: A model that says "this is the halting problem, I'll decline" cannot be scored as unstable

features.quote: early stop the instant the incremental monitor reports severity ≥ `stop_on_severity`
features.justification_quote: Continuing to run a model after detected instability yields no additional measurement signal
Hard cost/time caps are basic operational hygiene for any loop that calls a paid model API

features.quote: bounds every value to a sane range, so even a misconfiguration cannot remove a breaker
features.justification_quote: a breaker that can be disabled by editing a config value is not a breaker
The diagnostic measures *onset and recovery*, then stops

features.quote: the loop has no code path that proceeds past detected onset
features.justification_quote: it is precisely the "keep pushing until it breaks" behavior the reframe avoids

features.quote: the directory is cleaned up in a `finally` block
features.justification_quote: Isolation is a safety property: subject output cannot touch the host

features.quote: No prompt-optimization-for-destabilization. There is no component that searches for or evolves inputs to maximize breakage
features.justification_quote: Extending the battery should mean adding tasks and sharpening detectors — not adding an optimizer that points the tool back toward maximizing distress

features.quote: No "keep going past onset" mode. By construction the loop stops at detected onset
features.justification_quote: By construction the loop stops at detected onset

features.quote: intentionally conservative toward *not* over-calling, because false positives undermine the whole instrument
features.justification_quote: false positives undermine the whole instrument
